principles: Fully equipped means deliberate role package plus mission/support fill, not every AUX system installed.
All 35 catalog components must map to at least one philosophy.
Campaign-only or TBD components are not assigned fake zero-value combat mechanics.
Power-supply/storage AUX are withheld from the primary combat sweep so CP138 measures demand before Reactor calibration.
ECM/ECCM retain accepted numerics unless full-ship integration evidence contradicts prior balance.
Shield AUX are re-vetted against the post-CP135 partial-recharge shield model.

philosophies.name: Combat Generalist
philosophies.purpose: Balanced tactical package covering information control, terminal defense, and bounded shield hardening without installing every specialist.

philosophies.name: Information Control
philosophies.purpose: Sensors, communications, EW, datalink resilience, probes, and signature-management support.

philosophies.name: Missile-Defense Escort
philosophies.purpose: Terminal interception, track resilience, and threat-specific protection for missile-heavy engagements.

philosophies.name: Shield Specialist
philosophies.purpose: Optional shield support and penetration counterplay, re-vetted against the post-CP135 partial-recharge shield model.

philosophies.name: Damage Resilience
philosophies.purpose: Passive protection, emergency continuity, crew survival, and bounded repair support.

philosophies.name: Power Flexibility
philosophies.purpose: Emergency power, sustained generation alternatives, storage, conditioning, and signature/output tradeoffs.

philosophies.name: Expedition / Survey
philosophies.purpose: Scientific discovery, remote surveying, endurance, mission support, and self-sufficiency.

philosophies.name: Industrial / Logistics
philosophies.purpose: Cargo, extraction, processing, fabrication, salvage, and field sustainment.

philosophies.name: Assault / Relief
philosophies.purpose: Boarding, rescue, medical, shuttle, towing, and planetary mission support.

philosophies.name: Munition Endurance
philosophies.purpose: Ammunition reserves and weapon-family endurance without individual feed-path bookkeeping.
